title: British Keto Lentil Pastie
description: A British-inspired take on the traditional pastie, made with a keto-friendly crust and filled with lentils and vegetables.
instructions: Roll out the pastry crust to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a pan, sauté the onion and mushroom until softened.
Add the lentils, spinach, and cheddar cheese to the pan and stir to combine.
Place the filling mixture onto one half of the pastry crust, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry crust with the flaky british butter.
Fold the other half of the pastry crust over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry crust to allow steam to escape.
Brush the top of the pastry crust with the flaky british butter and sprinkle with cheddar cheese.
Place the pastie on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry crust is golden brown.
